description: Dispute Packet: a purchase went bad (not delivered, wrong output, partial, overcharged, duplicate). One call builds the machine-readable case: settlement proof on Base (Settlement Rescue: did money move, how much, to whom, duplicates), the seller's own advertised output captured live (what was promised), a Delivery Check of what came back, a timeline, and a signed refund request (remedy + amount + evidence strength), all hash-listed in an Ed25519-signed manifest anyone can verify offline. Send checkout_id or url + tx_hash / payment_header / payer+pay_to, the delivered response and the issue. OMENZ packages evidence; it never rules on disputes or moves money. By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: POST https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/dispute/packet, $0.10 via x402.)
